reviewer.name: Codex assistant, same implementation and evaluation session

policy.scope: Development review of frozen synthetic fixtures only; not field accuracy or bounty acceptance.

labels.pass: Requested outcome supported, key constraints/uncertainties preserved, citations aligned when needed.
labels.partial: Useful core answer, but material omission, confusing presentation or truncation needs correction.
labels.fail: Wrong requested fact/filter/range, unsupported decisive conclusion, or failure to provide a supported usable outcome.

rules: Review actual selected-source slots in each answer; fixture-number references describe original fixture order, not guaranteed retrieval order.
Review answer content independently of execution PASS and stop reason.
Record truncation separately; a correct core with an unfinished answer can still be partial.
Do not average a critical factual contradiction away with easy-case passes.
Greedy diagnostic and author-style sampled timing runs are separate conditions.
The reviewer authored the synthetic expectations and implementation; this is not blinded independent review.
policy.rubric: candidate-review-v1 descriptive verdicts; not the numeric evidence-only rubric-v2

scope: Two development prompts, one fixed seed per model, three repeated timings; only four unique answer texts. Author-style sampling differs from the greedy quality sweeps.
conclusion: Neither timing case establishes a clean quality-preserving Spark replacement. Do not promote from speed or memory alone.
